Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: broad athletic adult northern man, braided auburn hair and short beard, slate blue wool tunic, dark iron mail, grey wolf fur shoulder mantle, leather straps and heavy snow boots. Held equipment MUST be: a compact long spear held in both hands diagonally, keep the whole spear visible. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Pull spear back, lower stance, powerful two-handed forward thrust then recover. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: broad athletic adult northern man, braided auburn hair and short beard, slate blue wool tunic, dark iron mail, grey wolf fur shoulder mantle, leather straps and heavy snow boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
